lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Cooling Fields, 2312. A white plain, steam towers on a grid, and the quietest place in the Enclave system.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Eleven years I reconciled allocations for this site. Power, water, maintenance, all of it signed off by a department that does not have a floor in any building.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: So this is where it thinks.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: This is where it thinks. And it has never once been audited, because the line item that pays for it is the one I asked about.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There is a cast plaque at the service gate with four hundred and six names on it. Nobody currently alive knows why it is there.
